### F-099 — Deadlock helpers left 20 s timers behind and hung the test process

> _2026-08-19 · test/blong-int-sql · resolved_

The three deadlock helpers (`mysql/adapter/sql/sqlDeadlock{Builder,Trigger,ProcTrigger}.ts`) each
wrapped their work in a duplicated `withDeadlockTimeout` that raced a 20 s `setTimeout` through
`Promise.race` but never cleared the timer when the operation settled. Three referenced 20 s timers
therefore survived `platform.stop()`, so the test process only exited ~19 s later — locally ~24 s in
total, over tap's 30 s per-file limit in CI, which surfaced as `timeout!`.

Extracting a single shared `withDeadlockTimeout.ts` (an `export const`, no default export — the
loader ignores files without a default export) that clears the timer in `.finally` brought `ci-test`
down to ~8 s. Debug technique that worked: `process.getActiveResourcesInfo()` to spot the leaked
`Timeout` after an unref'd stdio red herring, then a timer registry capturing creation stacks to
identify the source.
